previous_statement: For a C^1 (class-one) manifold M, the domains of its allowable coordinate systems are open subsets whose union is M, hence form an open cover of M.
new_statement: For a C^1 manifold M (called a class-one manifold in GT-cairns-1935-theorem-p549), the domains of the allowable coordinate systems in its atlas are open subsets of M whose union is M.
